TOP ตู้ (ลูกค้า)
Box 480 × 480 × 700 sits on the floor (feet 50) between the four posts, centred.
Every face is 60 in from the post line: 36 clear of the tubes, 23 clear of the rosettes at the corners.
The 0.60 bars (460 and 660) run outside the box faces, so the box passes them; it stops 10 under the top at 760.
The service door is in the back panel, its top at 420, under the 460 bar (tube underside 436).
